facts.text: Brewers' 103-59 was the best record in MLB; Dodgers (100-62) were the only other 100-win team.
Worst records: Colorado Rockies 58-104 (worst MLB), San Francisco Giants 65-97; Angels (62-100) worst in AL.
Houston Astros (81-81) became the first team in MLB history to win a division without a winning record.
Dodgers clinched a 14th straight postseason berth (2013-2026), tying the Braves' record streak (1991-2005 excl. 1994).
Only the 4th time both Chicago teams made the postseason (1906, 2008, 2020, 2026).
Padres reached the postseason for a third straight year for the first time in franchise history.
One no-hitter in 2026: Houston combined (Tatsuya Imai 6 IP, Steven Okert, Alimber Santa in MLB debut) vs Texas on May 25 - the 18th no-hitter in Astros history.

Colson Montgomery (CWS) set the AL single-season strikeout record on Sep 24 with 223 (passing Adam Dunn, 2012; tying Mark Reynolds, 2009). A following entry says a player set the MLB record with a 224th K on Sep 25 and finished with 227; the page text read does not name that player in the lines read (likely Montgomery, unconfirmed).

A player named Wood (team not named in the lines read) entered the All-Star Break with a 21-run lead in runs scored, breaking Ted Williams' 1946 margin of 19; he had 89 runs, Bryan Reynolds (PIT) 68 second.
Chase DeLauter (CLE, Mar 26) and José Fernández (ARI, Mar 31) each homered twice in their MLB debut.
Munetaka Murakami (CWS): 10 HR in first 24 games, most ever by a Japanese-born player; 23rd HR on Jul 24 set rookie HR record for Japanese-born players, passing Shohei Ohtani (2018).
Tyler Glasnow (LAD) reached 1,000 career strikeouts in 793 IP on May 5, fastest by a starting pitcher.
Jacob deGrom (TEX) recorded his 2,000th career strikeout on Aug 20.
Season opened Mar 25 (Yankees at Giants); regular season ended Sep 27. Orioles-Yankees on Sep 27 was rained out and never made up.
Wild Card Series sweeps: all but Braves-Phillies were sweeps. Yankees' ALDS sweep loss was the first time the Yankees were swept in a postseason series outside ALCS/WS.
Rays swept the Yankees in the ALDS; Drew Rasmussen threw 8 shutout innings in Game 1 (Rays 1-0).
2026 World Series is scheduled to begin Oct 23, ending no later than Oct 31 (Game 7).
Stewart, Murakami (CWS) and Okamoto each reached 30+ HR in 2026, the first trio of rookies in MLB history to do so (Okamoto's 30th on Sep 8).

formatRules: 12 teams: 6 per league (3 division winners seeded 1-3 by record, 3 wild cards seeded 4-6 by record).
Seeds 1 and 2 (two best division winners) get a bye past the Wild Card Series.
Wild Card Series: best-of-3, all games hosted by the higher seed: (3) vs (6) and (4) vs (5).
Division Series: best-of-5; seeds 1 and 2 face the lowest-remaining wild card survivors (2-2-1 format, higher seed hosts G1, G2, G5).
League Championship Series and World Series: best-of-7 (LCS 2-3-2).
Home field in LCS goes to the better record unless both teams are wild cards; World Series home field goes to the better regular-season record (since 2017, not tied to All-Star Game).
No Game 163 tiebreaker games; ties broken by formula (since 2022).
